title: Decode an Ambisonic sound field natively, then render its spatial meaning separately

definition.title: Decode an Ambisonic sound field natively, then render its spatial meaning separately
definition.source_excerpt: Decode a restricted Opus Ambisonic component set through qualified browser decoders and apply the specified ordering, normalization and spatial renderer. Distinguish decoded components, rendered stereo and actual spatial hardware.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.

Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.

correctness.basis: Actual browser decode→native channel graph output is sample-identical to independently materialized software-matrix output for both six-channel permutation/gains and four ACN/SN3D directions. Wrong ordering and failure to stop a real stale source produce large errors; stop/disconnect/closed lifecycle passes. Seven-pair full decode/setup/render ratios1.05190 and1.05202 pass the predeclared1.10 cost ceiling; no speedup, CPU, energy or opaque-memory claim.
